description: rc.4: Settings has a Permissions section above App adapters: an Automation row with its live status (exactly 'Not allowed' or 'Allowed', from the same report onboarding reads) and an 'Open permission setup…' button that Tab reaches and Enter activates, switching the same window to onboarding and opening nothing
requirement: P2-settings-permissions (rc.4 parity, Tauri dist/index.html Settings › Permissions: set-auto, set-open-perms)
notes: Tauri reference (c82d048^): dist/index.html's Settings › Permissions group (Automation, 'Read the active app's link.', a status pill, 'Open permission setup…' → openSetup → showOnboarding).
The status comes from the `permission` fixture (views/onboarding.rs check_permissions), read off the main thread when Settings opens. 'Allowed' is matched exactly so 'Not allowed' cannot satisfy it.

Round 1 (permissions-two-missing.json): status 'Not allowed'; Tab to the button, Enter: route onboarding in the same window and process, nothing opened (the button opens onboarding, not System Settings).
Round 2 restarts and loads permissions-all-granted.json after the replay: status exactly 'Allowed', no 'Not allowed'.
On main (before the fix) Settings has no Permissions section, so round 1 fails at its first see.
